contracts.purpose: Specify how admitted business meaning may later align to an independently admitted system-runtime ontology without identity or authority collapse.
invariants: business and system endpoints retain independent identity and owner state
every endpoint resolves in its owned admitted model before a bridge instance can validate
no alignment implies implementation, conformance, authority, or cutover
allowed_readings: the contract defines future alignment requirements
the business endpoint meaning is available for DomainSpec authoring after owner admission
contracts.owner_route: ontology integration business-ontology owner plus future system-ontology owner
contracts.challenge_route: Business-ontology and system-ontology owners at their separate D65 gates

contracts.purpose: Identify one immutable Context-owned ontology view request.
invariants: context_ref resolves independently
semantic_cursor is singular
required subject identities are explicit
join policy and profile are registered
selector bytes are version exact
allowed_readings: the Context requests this bounded view
contracts.owner_route: Context product owner plus business-ontology owner

contracts.purpose: Define the exact consistent event prefix from which one ontology projection may be calculated.
invariants: semantic cursors are unique and contiguous
node and relation digest chains verify
no event after the selected cursor is included
every required governance reference resolves to an exact visible semantic event
allowed_readings: the cut is a complete input identity
the same cut can serve multiple bounded selectors without forking history
forbidden_collapses: latest per-subject states form a cut
contracts.owner_route: business-ontology owner plus ontology runtime owner
contracts.challenge_route: Ontology runtime owner plus integration conformance owner

contracts.purpose: Define the deterministic, rebuildable view delivered to a Context.
invariants: projection inputs resolve exactly
same exact selector and cut require the same semantic view digest
source cursor and event-set digest remain visible
projection cannot be consumed as a replay source
allowed_readings: bounded ontology view for the selector's intended use
forbidden_collapses: projection can append or replace source history
contracts.owner_route: business-ontology owner plus ontology runtime owner
contracts.challenge_route: Ontology runtime owner plus integration conformance owner

contracts.purpose: Permit one registered Context Selector to request one projection profile under one exact cut and governance-join policy.
invariants: all business endpoints resolve in this ontology or an admitted predecessor
source direction is canonical events to projection to Context
binding version and digest are exact
failure rules are collect-all and fail closed
allowed_readings: this registered Context request is eligible for this projection calculation
contracts.owner_route: Context product owner plus business-ontology owner
contracts.challenge_route: Context product owner plus business-ontology owner

contracts.purpose: Select exactly the governance events required for subjects visible at a semantic cut.
invariants: governance events name exact semantic event identities and digests
missing, stale, ambiguous, or mismatched selected references block delivery
unrelated ambient governance drift is diagnostic
allowed_readings: the view contains the governance facets required by its declared use
forbidden_collapses: latest governance state may be borrowed
contracts.challenge_route: Governance-model owner plus challenged semantic subject owner

contracts.purpose: Route a valid evidence, contradiction, or owner-review challenge to its responsible owner and gate.
invariants: challenge mode is one of evidence, contradiction, or owner-review
blocking consequence is scoped to declared dependencies
resolution appends evidence or a new owner decision and never rewrites history
allowed_readings: this is the valid disagreement and resolution path
contracts.owner_route: challenged subject owner plus business-ontology owner
contracts.challenge_route: Definitions-governance owner plus challenged subject owner

contracts.purpose: Bind the complete exact predecessor set used to evaluate one integration candidate.
invariants: unavailable later-stage members remain explicitly absent
material change to any populated member creates a successor epoch
epoch identity never implies lifecycle promotion or release
allowed_readings: which exact predecessors were evaluated together
which later predecessor positions remain unfilled
contracts.owner_route: Ontology Lifecycle Project owner plus all predecessor owners
contracts.challenge_route: Ontology Lifecycle Project owner plus changed predecessor owner
